s0401.literal: Cotton tribute intendant offices were established in Zhedong, Jiangdong, Jiangxi, Huguang, and Fujian; the people were required to pay one hundred thousand bolts of cotton annually, overseen by a metropolitan intendant office.
s0401.idiomatic: Cotton tribute intendant offices were established in Zhedong, Jiangdong, Jiangxi, Huguang, and Fujian; the people were required to pay 100,000 bolts of cotton annually, overseen by a metropolitan intendant office.

s0402.literal: The judicial officer Yesen set up by imperial grandson Atam-buqa was abolished, and his seal was seized.
s0402.idiomatic: The judicial officer Yesen set up by imperial grandson Atam-buqa was abolished, and his seal was seized.

s0403.literal: Ministry secretariat officials said: "The Gongchang convenient metropolitan commandery has already been promoted to a pacification commission; we request that a separate subordinate prefecture be established for the old concurrent prefectural duties, with officials assigned to govern separately.
s0403.idiomatic: Ministry secretariat officials said, "The Gongchang convenient metropolitan commandery had already been promoted to a pacification commission; we request that a separate subordinate prefecture be established for the old concurrent prefectural duties, with officials assigned to govern separately.

s0405.idiomatic: An artisan intendant office for Prince Ai-ya-chi's following was established at Yidu.

s0406.literal: Prefectures and counties of Yunnan's Dali, Zhongqing, and other routes were consolidated.
s0406.idiomatic: Prefectures and counties of Yunnan's Dali, Zhongqing, and other routes were consolidated.

s0407.literal: On dingchou day the market magistrate office was promoted to rank 5b.
s0407.idiomatic: On dingchou day the market magistrate office was promoted to rank 5b.

s0408.literal: The Dadu Route armor-craftsmen commission was renamed the weapons artisans grand commission.
s0408.idiomatic: The Dadu Route armor-craftsmen commission was renamed the weapons artisans grand commission.

s0409.literal: Ministry secretariat officials said: "Nayan was executed for rebellion; his households are given seventeen thousand five hundred twenty-three shi of rice monthly; their parents, wives, and children are all in the north, and lest they harbor other designs, we request they be moved to Jiangnan to serve as the naval troops for the sea ships Shabuding requested.

s0411.literal: Fifth month, on gengchen day one thousand Imperial Guard troops were dispatched to dredge the transport canal from Hexiwu to Tongzhou.
s0411.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengchen day 1,000 Imperial Guard troops were dispatched to dredge the transport canal from Hexiwu to Tongzhou.

s0413.literal: On renchen day Venus transgressed Ghost.
s0413.idiomatic: On renchen day Venus transgressed Ghost.

s0414.literal: Ruanu Wang Shu had privately given gold and silver vessels to princes Chubo, Heban, and others; because his provisioning had been laborious, officials were ordered to compensate him in full, and he was further rewarded with fifty thousand taels of silver and two thousand bolts each of silks.
s0414.idiomatic: Ruanu Wang Shu had privately given gold and silver vessels to princes Chubo, Heban, and others; because his provisioning had been laborious, officials were ordered to compensate him in full, and he was further rewarded with 50,000 taels of silver and 2,000 bolts each of silks.

s0415.literal: On bingzhen day an edict said: "The thirty-thousand-household army of Jiyang, Yidu, and Zilai has long garrisoned Guangdong; many have died of plague; let them rotate every two years.

s0416.literal: " Bandit Zhong Mingliang led eighteen thousand five hundred seventy-three men to surrender; armies levied from Jiang-Huai, Fujian, and Jiangxi provinces each returned to their original wings.
s0416.idiomatic: " Bandit Zhong Mingliang led 18,573 men to surrender; armies levied from Jiang-Huai, Fujian, and Jiangxi provinces each returned to their original wings.

s0417.idiomatic: The mobile censorate was again moved to Yangzhou; the Zhexi surveillance commission was moved to Suzhou.

s0418.literal: Associate administrator Xindu was made left vice chancellor of the Ministry secretariat; Central Secretariat associate administrator He Rongzu was made associate administrator; Secretariat deliberator Zhang Tianyou was made Central Secretariat associate administrator.
s0418.idiomatic: Associate administrator Xindu was made left vice chancellor of the ministry secretariat; central secretariat associate administrator He Rongzu was made associate administrator; secretariat deliberator Zhang Tianyou was made central secretariat associate administrator.

s0419.literal: On jihai day a Huihui imperial academy was established.
s0419.idiomatic: On jihai day a Huihui imperial academy was established.

s0420.literal: The Utilization Directorate was promoted to rank 3b.
s0420.idiomatic: The utilization directorate was promoted to rank 3b.

s0421.idiomatic: Liaoyang Route suffered famine; unpaid field rents from previous years were remitted.

s0422.literal: Ministry secretariat officials said: "Registering unregistered people and human slaves as proper households in Datong, Pingyang, and Taiyuan has already shown some effect.
s0422.idiomatic: Ministry secretariat officials said, "Registering unregistered people and human slaves as proper households in Datong, Pingyang, and Taiyuan had already shown some effect.

s0423.idiomatic: The circuits of Yidu, Jinan, and others should also be treated likewise.

s0427.idiomatic: Because Zhuanglang Route was far from Gansu Province, it was transferred to the jurisdiction of Anxi Province.

s0428.literal: Liujiang County was abolished and merged into Qu Prefecture.
s0428.idiomatic: Liujiang County was abolished and merged into Qu Prefecture.

s0429.idiomatic: The Taian Temple military colony suffered great flooding; this year's rent was remitted.

s0430.idiomatic: The Qingshan Maoman submitted in succession from 33 stockades including Bumotai and Beibao.

s0432.literal: On jiyou day Gongchang Wang Weihe said: "Recently Han weapons were confiscated; within my jurisdiction they have already been completely banned; from now on whenever I need weapons, I request they be taken from the Anxi official armory.

s0433.literal: " The Emperor said: "Your family is not to be compared with other Han; bows and arrows are not forbidden to you — you may keep them as you wish.

s0434.idiomatic: " On xinhai day an edict said that because Yunnan branch secretariat territory was distant and many prefecture and county posts were vacant, for ranks six and below, the province was permitted to select and appoint officials and report.

s0437.literal: On gengshen day Prince Naimandai defeated Hedan's troops on the Tuowu'er River.
s0437.idiomatic: On gengshen day Prince Naimandai defeated Hedan's troops on the Tuowu'er River.

s0457.idiomatic: " An edict granted it the name Huitong River and established an intendant office charged with canal affairs.
